parts.note: B is the grade for second class, as in B-list
a feller is one who fells trees, a logger

explanation.surface: A disparaging remark about an internet writer being a second-rate chap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feller' reads as slang for a fellow, but here it is one who fells trees.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who writes a web log, posting online, is described by this word.

indicators.note: the opening letter of bass is used

parts.note: to weigh anchor is to raise it

explanation.surface: Fish prepared after first being put on the scales.
explanation.walkthrough: 'weighed' suggests scales, but sailors weigh, meaning lift, an anchor.
explanation.definitionFit: Stewed slowly in a little liquid in a closed pot.

clue.text: All family members at home in Scots island?

parts.note: if all of them are at home then none are out, a nought, the letter O
kin are relatives
Scots awa' means away, so with everyone at home it is O kin awa', no kin away

explanation.surface: A Scottish family gathered at home on an island.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as O KIN AWA it reads, in Scots, 'no kin away': all the family at home. The question mark admits the island is not Scottish at all but Japanese.
explanation.definitionFit: The largest of Japan's Ryukyu chain, a southern island prefecture.

clue.text: Live wire round pole? One's had it!

indicators.note: the lively person's letters go round the pole letter

parts.note: a goer is an energetic, lively person
N is the north pole

explanation.surface: An electric cable wrapped round a post spells death for someone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Live wire' sounds electrical but means a dynamic person.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone or something doomed or past saving is a lost cause.

clue.text: Bean soup — nothing less for seconds?

parts.note: a runner is a climbing bean, the runner bean

indicators.note: less means minus, so a letter goes from soup

parts.note: O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A diner wanting second helpings of bean soup with nothing missing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'seconds' suggests more food; it means those placed second.
explanation.definitionFit: Those finishing second in a contest are the competitors behind the winner.

parts.note: reads like asking for a telephone line out of an office, but describes a straight line touching a circle from outside

explanation.walkthrough: The telephone reading of 'outside line' and 'ring' is the misdirection; in geometry the line just touches the ring (circle) at one point outside it.
explanation.definitionFit: In geometry this is a straight line meeting a circle at a single point without crossing into it.

indicators.note: shows means displays, so the letters are visible within the words important as team

explanation.surface: A sports comment that track record matters as the side reveals.
explanation.definitionFit: To try or sample something is to undergo it, as in a brief trial.

indicators.note: the champion loses his head, his first letter

parts.note: a knight is a champion who fights for a cause
a mounted rider sits on a horse, here a mare

explanation.surface: A beheaded horseman, like a ghost story's headless rider, is a horror.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mounted' supplies what the champion is mounted on, a female horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A bad dream that frightens, or any frightful experience.

parts.note: a motive is what drives someone to act

explanation.surface: A divisive racing driver from Europe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'driver' suggests a motorist but means a motivating force.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue that stirs feelings and argument is described as arousing emotion.

indicators.note: the word for raucous loses its opening letter

parts.note: strident means loud and harsh

explanation.surface: An order to stop noisy chattering.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jabber' reads as chatter; it is a thing that jabs.
explanation.definitionFit: A three-pronged spear, the weapon of Neptune, is something that jabs.

clue.text: Article about wine that covers grand French location

indicators.note: the article goes around the rest, so it sits about it

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

indicators.note: the wine word is wrapped over the letter for grand

parts.note: vino is informal for wine
G is short for grand, a thousand

explanation.surface: Talk of a wine label wrapped round a bottle from a fine French place.
explanation.walkthrough: The inner part is VIGNO; 'about' is the container signal, not ON as one might expect.
explanation.definitionFit: A city in Provence, once seat of the popes, so a place in France.

clue.text: Such gentlemen as have origins abroad?

definitions.text: Such gentlemen as have origins abroad?

indicators.note: abroad can mean astray or all over the place, so these letters are scattered into a new order

explanation.surface: A remark on men whose families came from overseas.
explanation.walkthrough: 'abroad' rearranges ORIGINS; the whole clue also describes Italian gentlemen, whose title comes from abroad.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the Italian plural for gentlemen or misters, a form of address used in Italy.

parts.note: reads as a big inhalation, but the deep is the ocean and the breath a light wind off it

explanation.walkthrough: 'Deep' as a noun is the sea; a 'breath' of air is a gentle wind.
explanation.definitionFit: A cool wind blowing in from the ocean is a breath from the deep.

definitions.meaning: cow's stomach lining is eaten as food by some people

explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests gullible people swallowing nonsense; the second sense is literal eating of offal.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both rubbish talk and the edible stomach lining of cattle.

clue.text: US prosecutor holding sheep in tense situation

indicators.note: the prosecutor's letters hold the sheep between them

parts.note: DA is a District Attorney, an American public prosecutor
a ram is a male sheep

explanation.surface: An American attorney grabbing livestock at a fraught moment.
explanation.definitionFit: A tense, exciting turn of events is often called this, as in making a fuss or crisis.

indicators.note: shattered means broken into pieces, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Rock smashed apart in an explosion zone.
explanation.definitionFit: A fine white translucent mineral used for carving ornaments.

clue.text: State capital has no love for religious ritual

indicators.note: the capital loses a letter, the one meaning love

parts.note: Sacramento is the capital of California
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A cold, loveless capital city where religion is observed.
explanation.definitionFit: A Christian rite such as baptism or the Eucharist is called this.

definitions.meaning: permission to go ahead, an all-clear
space left over, as headroom under a bridge

explanation.walkthrough: 'spare room' suggests a guest bedroom but means free space.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both official permission and the clear gap between objects.

clue.text: Long drink containing very soft fruit

parts.note: to pine is to long for

indicators.note: the beer word holds the musical letters inside it

parts.note: ale is beer
pp is pianissimo, very soft in music

explanation.surface: A tall cocktail with a mushy tropical fruit in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Long drink' looks like one phrase meaning a tall glass, but splits into two separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: A tropical plant bearing a large spiky-skinned sweet yellow fruit.

indicators.note: these letters go in the word for immaculate

parts.note: pure means spotless, immaculate
O is the cricket abbreviation for over

explanation.surface: A spotless horse-drawn coach passing along a road.
explanation.walkthrough: 'carriage' suggests a vehicle but means bearing, how one holds oneself.
explanation.definitionFit: The way a person holds their body is their bearing or stance.

indicators.note: smashed like broken china, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Breaking someone's fine porcelain to get even.
explanation.walkthrough: Meissen is a German town famed for fine porcelain.
explanation.definitionFit: Named for the Greek goddess of vengeance, it means deserved punishment or downfall.

clue.text: Odds in rugby tournament slashed at the outset

parts.note: Sevens is the seven-a-side rugby format and its tournaments, such as the Hong Kong Sevens

explanation.definitionFit: Betting odds of one to one, where the stake is doubled if it wins.

clue.text: A royal flag from the South African nation

indicators.note: in a down clue, reading from the bottom upward runs the letters backwards

parts.note: ER is the Queen, Elizabeth Regina
to flag is to tire

explanation.surface: A royal banner flown in southern Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flag' looks like a banner but means to weaken.
explanation.definitionFit: A country in the Horn of Africa on the Red Sea coast.

definitions.meaning: with the shell or pod taken off, like peas

explanation.walkthrough: 'casing' sounds like a bomb's case but refers to husks.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both bombarded with shells and stripped of husks.

indicators.note: the graduates are set the other way round, read from back to front

explanation.definitionFit: A lively Brazilian ballroom and carnival style of dancing.

indicators.note: the soldier's letters catch the fish inside them

the gar is a long-snouted fish

explanation.walkthrough: 'Fat' looks like an adjective for the soldier but is the definition, a noun.
explanation.definitionFit: A butter substitute is a spreading fat made from vegetable oils.

clue.text: Not happy, one male brought up to be king

parts.note: sad means not happy
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A miserable man raised to the throne.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought up' reverses SADIM.
explanation.definitionFit: The legendary Phrygian monarch whose touch turned everything to gold.

clue.text: British in Australia finally denounce exploitation

indicators.note: the letter goes in the abbreviation for Australia
the last letter of denounce is used

explanation.surface: A Briton down under criticising unfair treatment.

clue.text: Wanting more? Time to tuck into whipped sundae!

whipped like cream, so the letters of sundae are beaten into a new order

explanation.surface: Still hungry? Time to dig into an ice-cream dessert.

clue.text: Follows to protect king and makes secure

parts.note: ensues means follows on
R is short for rex, king

clue.text: Gem dealer nuts to accept million

explanation.surface: A crazy jeweller agreeing to a million for a stone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nuts' rearranges DEALER; 'to accept' places M inside.
explanation.definitionFit: A precious green stone, a variety of beryl.
